title: Verification plan
description: Written by the verifier in mode plan, before any evidence exists. The factory joins it to the approved spec (one entry per criterion, in order, with the spec's tags; unique ids and names; confined test paths) and only then executes it: it runs the tests, starts the preview, and takes the captures. Expectations are committed here so the judgment cannot be fitted to the evidence afterwards.

specSetSha256.description: specSet.sha256 from the run brief: the approved spec file set the plan was written against.

criteria.description: One entry per criterion in spec.md, in order. None may be left out.

method.description: test: named tests the factory runs. capture: page captures the factory takes. manual: an owner checklist item. unsupported: the factory has no way to observe this criterion.

instruction.description: What the owner does, as one instruction.

reason.description: For unsupported: why no test or capture can observe the criterion.

id.description: Unique in the plan: t1, t2, and so on.

file.description: Repo-relative path of the test file at headSha. The factory runs a test only by a path that is confined to the repository and tracked at headSha.

name.description: The full test name as the runner prints it.

reproduction.description: True for the AC-1 test of a bug: the factory also runs it with the head's test files on the base's code, where it must fail by the assertion the criterion describes.

id.description: Unique in the plan: c1, c2, and so on.

name.description: Unique in the plan. The factory appends the side and the viewport to name each record and screenshot.

route.description: Path, query, and fragment only. The factory joins it to the preview's own origin; a capture that leaves that origin fails.

fixture.description: A fixture name from project.fixtures, or none when the project declares no fixtures.

viewports.description: Both fixed viewports, always: desktop is 1440x900 and mobile is 390x844.

sides.description: base and head for a before and after pair. head alone only when the route does not exist at baseSha.

expect.description: What the head capture must show, committed before any capture is taken.

headText.description: Strings that must each appear in the head page text.

headTextAbsent.description: Strings that must not appear in the head page text.

headTextInOrder.description: Strings that must appear in the head page text in this order. Empty when order does not matter.

differsFromBase.description: True when the head screenshot must differ from the base screenshot at the same viewport. null when sides has no base.

allowedConsoleErrors.description: Substrings of console errors the criterion itself expects. Usually empty.

visible.description: What must be visible in the screenshot, in plain words, for the judge to check against the pixels.

repoPath.description: A relative path with forward slashes and no . or .. segment.
